fixture_note: FIXTURE DATA. Fictional businesses served from local test servers; the PageSpeed API was replaced by a stub that returns fixed numbers, so every speed figure in this run is made up for the demonstration. Nothing in this run is a real measurement of a real business.

methodology.summary: Public pages were read once with a limited crawl. Speed was measured with Google PageSpeed Insights (Lighthouse) on mobile. Comparison businesses were chosen from the sources listed below.
methodology.disclaimer: Lighthouse scores are lab test results, not Google ranking scores.

competitors.selection_note: No supported business search source is switched on, so only the competitor you named is compared.

relevance.note: Named by you. Relevance not checked by a supported source.

recommendations.title: Your home page was not served over HTTPS
recommendations.found: The home page was served without HTTPS in the check on 20 Nov 2026.
recommendations.why_it_may_matter: Browsers may show a warning on pages that are not secure, and visitors may be unwilling to send details. Search engines list secure addresses as one signal among many.
recommendations.what_could_change: Install a certificate and redirect all pages to the secure address.
check_before_implementation: Check how your hosting handles certificates.
Check that links and images load securely after the change.

basis.rule: Severity 3 x confidence high = 9 (high if 6 or more, medium if 3 to 5, low below 3). A measured observation. Effort (low) only orders items with the same score.

recommendations.title: Automatic accessibility checks found items to review
recommendations.found: The Lighthouse accessibility checks scored 88 out of 100 in the mobile test recorded on 20 Nov 2026.
recommendations.why_it_may_matter: Accessible pages are easier for more people to use. Automatic checks find only part of the possible problems.
recommendations.what_could_change: Review the failed checks, for example contrast, labels and image descriptions.
check_before_implementation: Test with a keyboard and a screen reader as well.

basis.rule: Severity 2 x confidence high = 6 (high if 6 or more, medium if 3 to 5, low below 3). A measured observation. Effort (medium) only orders items with the same score.

caveats: Lighthouse scores are not Google ranking scores.
A high score would not mean the page is accessible.

recommendations.what_could_change: Compress and resize images, reduce render blocking scripts, review hosting.
check_before_implementation: Confirm with a second test and real visitor data if you have it.

recommendations.what_could_change: A possible workflow in which each quote is recorded with a date and status, a follow up is prepared when no reply has been recorded by the agreed date, and further follow ups stop when the quote is accepted, declined or closed.
